ci_support_linux_64_python3.10.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
name: zopfli
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.4.3"

package:
  name: zopfli
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/z/zopfli/zopfli-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d3a50f91a13cea9bafe025de8fd87a005eb26de02a4f0c193127ddbf23ac8ebe

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - setuptools_scm
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - zopfli
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - README.rst
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script:
      - pytest

about:
  license_file: COPYING
  license: Apache-2.0
  summary: Zopfli module for python
  homepage: https://github.com/obp/zopfli
  repository: https://github.com/obp/zopfli

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jakirkham
    - mgorny
